exposure: uterine artery chemoembolization (UACE) combined with curettage
cohort: 383 women with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) treated by UACE with curettage at Women's Hospital of Zhejiang University, Hangzhou, China, between December 2006 and December 2016
finding: UACE combined with curettage was found to be an effective fertility-sparing treatment for CSP, with high rates of treatment success, menstrual resumption, and successful future pregnancies.
